page_title: LAZ 2-0 TOR | Lazio v Torino 27/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' Luis Alberto (Lazio) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+8' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
90+6' The Torino players are stunned as referee Michael Fabbri changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
90+4' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Torino using VAR. Let's see what happens.
90+4' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) probably handled the ball inside the penalty area. PENALTY! One of the players from Torino is about to take a penalty kick.
90+3' Torino hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The game is interrupted now, Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

88' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
82' Samuele Ricci (Torino) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
80' The substitution is prepared. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mattia Zaccagni.
80' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Manuel Lazzari and he is replaced by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
79' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pietro Pellegri is coming onto the pitch as Valentino Lazaro (Torino) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Substitution. Raoul Bellanova (Torino) makes way for Brandon Soppy.

76' 2 - 0 Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 2:0.
75' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) replaces Ciro Immobile.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matias Vecino trots off the pitch and is replaced by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio).
74' The referee has issued a yellow card to Perr Schuurs (Torino).
74' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is awarded a yellow card and sent off by Michael Fabbri because it's his second one today.
69' 3:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' The whistle blows and Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is booked for an infringement.

63' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
62' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is caught offside!
60' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Adrien Tameze is replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
60' A substitution has been made. Duvan Zapata goes off and Nemanja Radonjic (Torino) comes on.

56' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Matias Vecino (Lazio) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Manuel Lazzari. The score is now 1:0.
53' Perr Schuurs (Torino) jumps into a tackle and Michael Fabbri signals a foul. It's a free kick to Lazio in a dangerous position.
51' Samuele Ricci (Torino) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' What was Adrien Tameze (Torino) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The corner is swung in but Lazio can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. Lazio will take a corner kick.
39' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
31' Lazio keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.

29' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
28' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul after Luis Alberto (Lazio) hacks down one of his opponents. Torino will take a free kick near the side line.
27' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Alessandro Buongiorno is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Saba Sazonov (Torino).
26' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 1:2.
20' Michael Fabbri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Felipe Anderson (Lazio). Torino are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
17' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
17' Luis Alberto (Lazio) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
17' The resulting corner from Luis Alberto (Lazio) comes to nothing. Lazio will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
17' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
16' The Lazio players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) brings an opponent down and Michael Fabbri interrupts the game. Free kick. Lazio will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
6' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes a short corner kick.
6' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lazio will have the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
